blocks.text: A Tampa CPA Discusses Office Frugality: Cutting Costs in the Workplace

No matter how much a business is thriving, it’s always wise to keep a close eye on the big and small expenses that constantly assault the bottom line. That means taking the time to annually review costs for big-ticket items, like insurance and travel. But it also means scrutinizing the costs of day-to-day activities in the office, which can be an almost invisible drain on monetary resources.

A [Tampa CPA](http://www.reliancecpa.com/) from Reliance Consulting, LLC, can help make sure your company is getting the most out of its revenue streams. Accurate record-keeping is a start, whether it’s through QuickBooks or another financial software. Smart tax planning is another good way to save money, and Reliance can help with that, as well.
But there are other, simple steps a company owner or office manager can take to keep costs to a minimum, including:

items.text: Use refurbished office furniture, rather than buying new every time.
Don’t leave lights on in unused rooms.
Store files electronically, rather than in printed form, when possible.
If printing is necessary, avoid the excessive use of color ink, if possible.
Upgrade software and memory capacity on the company network, rather than buying new computers every year.
